metadata.name: Branch onboarding
metadata.description: A branch library joining: the branch says who it is, picks the integrations it needs, and runs the setup of each one it picked, in the order the response lists them, each as a durable child execution of its own. The pick is a multi-select whose values are the setups' document ids; a core.foreach walks the response and a core.subchart names its child from the loop's item (chart_from), so which children run is data. The branch's own steps are myapp.step blocks, so Back works between them; Back does not cross into or out of a setup.

datamodel.description: What the branch's own steps collected, keyed by question key: the branch's name and the integrations it picked, as the setups' document ids. Each setup's own responses stay in the setup's own execution.
